task.title: Using Duo Multifactor Authentication
task.shortdesc: Using Duo multifactor authentication (MFA) at NC State. Duo ensures that all individuals affiliated with the university are protected from unauthorized access to an NC State unity account.

taskbody.prereq: You must have Duo downloaded onto a personal device before using Duo.
taskbody.context: NC State uses Duo as its MFA system that works to authenticate Unity ID logins. You can authenticate through Duo using Duo Push, using a passcode in the Mobile App, using a Security Key, or using a one time Duo bypass code.

step.cmd: Log in with your NC State Unity ID and password.
In the Second Password field, type 'push'.
step.note: You will receive a notification from the Duo app asking if you are attempting to sign in.

step.cmd: Once the Duo pop-up appears, select "Approve".

steps.stepsection: Using a Passcode from the Duo Mobile App

step.cmd: Log in with your NC State Unity ID and password.
Select the section labeled Duo Protected - NC State University.
Enter the 6-digit code that appears on your phone into the Second Password field of the VPN client.

steps.stepsection: Using a Passcode from the Duo One-Time Passcode Tool (Security Key Owners)

step.note: If you only have a Security Key enrolled for your Duo Login you can use this tool to generate a code to use in the VPN Client.
step.cmd: Go to the go.ncsu.edu/dc and sign in with your Unity ID and password
Select the Generate New Passcode button.
Enter the 9-digit code that appears in the Second Password field of the VPN client.
Call 919-515-4357 and ask for a bypass code (available 24/7) or visit our Walk-in Center.
Once verified, we'll provide you with a 9-digit code.
Enter that 9-digit code in the Second Password field of the VPN client.
